default.title: Unexpected application error
default.description: An unexpected issue occurred while processing your request.

unauthorized.title: Unauthorized access
unauthorized.description: Your current session is not authorized to access this resource.

forbidden.title: Access restricted
forbidden.description: You do not currently have permission to continue.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The requested route may have been removed or is unavailable.

serverError.title: Internal server error
serverError.description: The server encountered an issue while handling your request.

notFoundPage.description: The page you are trying to access may have been removed, moved to another route, or is no longer available in the current interview session.

unauthorizedAccess.heading: Access Denied
unauthorizedAccess.description: Your session link is missing or has expired. Please use the link provided in your invitation email to access the interview.

boundary.heading: Something went wrong here
boundary.description: This section failed to load. Your interview is still running — you can retry without losing your session.
